title: The Dark Below Portland Adults Only Haunted Ghost Tour
includes: A guided haunted and historical walking tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Beneath Portland's vibrant streets lies a darker story. Join The Dark Below and explore the city's most chilling legends, notorious crimes, and haunted landmarks. Journey through historic Old Town and Chinatown as your guide uncovers tales of Shanghaiing, underground tunnels, tragic deaths, unsolved mysteries, and the restless spirits said to linger where Portland's darkest history unfolded.

Visit iconic locations including the Shanghai Tunnel district, Old Town Pizza & Brewing, the Roseland Theater, Kells Irish Pub, and the waterfront where kidnapped sailors were once forced aboard ships bound for distant ports. Along the way, discover stories of vice, disappearances, and paranormal encounters that helped shape Portland's haunted reputation.

Combining authentic local history, true crime, and ghost lore, The Dark Below offers an unforgettable journey into the shadows of one of the Pacific Northwest's most haunted cities. Guests must be at least 16 years old to participate.
